title: Safer sync and table trust, a reworked World
items: Cloud-folder sync merges changes from two devices instead of overwriting one with the other.
At the Table, the GM's copy is the authority: players can only change characters they've claimed.
The World page was reworked, and two worlds merge cleanly.

title: Phone app, share links and Battle map 2.0
items: Install DCUGen to a phone's home screen; it opens full screen and works offline.
Share a whole roster, world or folder as one link.
Battle map 2.0: build a city, weather, grounds and a 3D view.
Session in a Box, phone tables, the rogues' gallery and fight comics.

title: GM Screen, undo and history, alternate forms
items: GM Screen with a balance check, adapting villains, spotlight and recaps.
Points from the GM, saved points and goals on the sheet; a range calculator.
Undo and history, cloud-folder sync, the Play view, full exports and house rules.
Drain that follows the rules, alternate forms, and companions with full sheets.
Power Lab: descriptions, Linked effects and Dynamic arrays.

title: Worlds, handouts and the Newsstand
items: Worlds and the Multiverse Hub; the open character survives a reload.
Newsstand: front pages of the campaign's newspapers.
